trait.magitinkerer.description.sea_frien: While underwater, removes the mining speed penalties from being submerged and off the ground.
trait.magitinkerer.description.soulhunte:
Exposes souls on hit.
Each Soulhunter level beyond I counts as one level of Spirit Plunder.
trait.magitinkerer.description.steadfast:
High durability boosts Attack, Element, Range, and Defense.
Repairable with dedicated equipment.
trait.magitinkerer.description.hollow:
Boosts Handling, Continuity, Range, and Unique.
Reduces maximum durability based on the combined level of Hollow and Intensify.
trait.magitinkerer.description.intensify:
Boosts Attack and Element.
Reduces maximum durability based on the combined level of Hollow and Intensify.
item.magitinkerer.signum_thread.desc_1: Reproduces the effect of the %s Thread Page when used.
item.magitinkerer.signum_thread.desc_3: Draws mana from its bearer and stores it for use.
item.magitinkerer.spatial_distortion_mir: Reproduces the effect of the %s Thread Page when used.
Works only when the destination is in the same dimension.
item.magitinkerer.dimension_distortion_m: Reproduces the effect of the %s Thread Page when used.
tooltip.block.magitinkerer.maneuvering_c: What became of them after they lost their purity.
The wall looks paper-thin from here. It is impossibly thick.
tooltip.block.magitinkerer.restraint_coa: Held down by innocence itself, they resist in their own way.
It seems to let everything through, yet it holds everything captive.
tooltip.block.magitinkerer.mana_durum_me: Still far from indestructible, with far too many prerequisites.
tooltip.hint.block.magitinkerer.mana_dur: Uses mana to mend tools made with Durusium.
tooltip.item.magitinkerer.durusium_ingot: A dreaming scientist seeks a material that will never break.
tooltip.item.magitinkerer.signum_thread: What blasphemy, to recreate a goddess's miracle with engineering and magic.
tooltip.item.magitinkerer.spatial_distor: A portal this small ought to be usable like a spell.
tooltip.item.magitinkerer.dimension_dist: Across space and between dimensions, for the one I love.
message.magitinkerer.signum_thread.denie: Cannot be used in this dimension!
message.magitinkerer.spatial_distortion_: Your respawn point is in another dimension.
